status: orientation set on 2026-11-05 (supervisor-approved exception: text-to-image coordinate alignment); everything else unchanged since commit cb5687d and fixed before any spatial score is computed

scope.split: val (development data only; test split refused by src/phase4/guard.py)

lang_masks.C2: runs/phase3/val/lang/ddcmd/QaTa-COV19/seed1001/masks_C2_0.npz (job 371, the Phase 3 rerun scored by Phase 3; not the job 370 C2 masks)

sources.groups_and_partitions: results/phase3_gate_partitions.csv (GATE_FIT / GATE_CAL, Phase 3 groups; not regrouped)
sources.manifest: src/phase2/conditions.py build('QaTa-COV19', 'val'), eligible rows (frozen Phase 2 rules)
sources.location: src/phase2/texts.py attributes('QaTa-COV19', 'val'), field 'location', including the frozen D5 typo rules; for C4-C6 rows the donor's own location (the counterfactual text equals the donor's report)

grid.array: common 224 x 224; row 0 = top, column 0 = image left; LANG, IMG and ground truth share this layout (no flip, transpose or rotation at evaluation)
grid.row_rule: edges round(224 k / 3) for k = 1, 2 -> 75, 149; cells are 75 / 74 / 75 rows
grid.note: image-coordinate proxy, not a lung-zone segmentation; ground-truth masks are not used to define regions

options_in_code.max_of_both: both mappings computed, the higher agreement kept per row

orientation.rule: set once by a separate commit before any spatial score is computed; never chosen from scores
orientation.meaning: text-to-image coordinate alignment: a report's 'left' is image columns 0-111 and 'right' is columns 112-223; 'upper' / 'middle' / 'lower' are image rows 0-74 / 75-148 / 149-223 as in the plan's grid. This is NOT the patient's anatomical orientation (in standard chest X-ray display the patient's left is usually on the image right). The code name 'patient_left_on_image_left' is kept only for compatibility.

lookup.rule: location 'left:<zones>;right:<zones>' (patient sides); zones of one side are united; 'all' = upper + middle + lower of that side; the cells of both sides are united
lookup.unavailable: empty / not parsed location, any side 'unspecified', an unknown zone token
lookup.coverage_of_table: every location value of the QaTa validation targets and of every C4-C6 donor row of the frozen manifest

unavailable_rules.lateral_view: file name contains '_vp-ll_' (project lead's rule 2026-11-03); covid_* and sub-* without a view token are kept
unavailable_rules.img_empty: IMG binary mask has no lesion pixel
unavailable_rules.location_unknown_token: a token outside left/right and upper/middle/lower/all
unavailable_rules.treatment: unavailable is not 0 and not 'incorrect'; such rows keep the F1-F5 (Baseline LR) decision in later stages

score.spatial_agreement: IMG lesion pixels in the report-allowed cells / all IMG lesion pixels
score.mask: frozen IMG binary mask only (never the ground truth, never LANG)

stage0.denominator: QaTa validation targets eligible (frozen manifest) for C0, >= 1 location-only C4 donor (changed_attributes == 'location') and >= 1 C6 donor
stage0.eligible_target: not lateral, IMG nonempty, C0 location mappable, >= 1 mappable location-only C4 donor, >= 1 mappable C6 donor
stage0.eligible_group: a group with at least one eligible denominator image (groups with all images eligible are reported descriptively)
stage0.criterion: GO only if the orientation is established by the supervisor-approved rule without medical judgment AND eligible images >= 80% and eligible groups >= 80% of the denominator (whole validation set); GATE_FIT and GATE_CAL are reported separately
stage0.fixed: the denominator is not changed after any outcome is seen

stage1.data: Stage 0-eligible targets in GATE_FIT only; DD-CMD seed 1001; frozen C0, C4 location-only and C6 assignments
stage1.per_target_scores: C0: the target's score; C4: mean of the available location-only C4 donor scores; C6: mean of the available C6 donor scores
stage1.auroc: image level, two values per target (C0 label 0, donor-averaged C4 label 1), score = spatial_mismatch, sklearn roc_auc_score (ties count one half); descriptive repeat for C0 vs donor-averaged C6
stage1.paired_difference: image-weighted mean of [C4 - C0] and of [C6 - C0] spatial_mismatch over the same targets; group-level summaries reported descriptively
stage1.criterion: continue only if AUROC(C0 vs C4 location-only) >= 0.65 AND mean(C4 - C0) > 0 AND mean(C6 - C0) > 0; engineering screening criteria, not significance tests
stage1.no_rescue: no alternative grid, mapping, mask threshold or feature after a failure

orientation_decision.basis: option 1 on the training split: convention 'patient_left_on_image_left' agrees with 96.1% of 1,129 one-sided reports, all 7 pre-set criteria met (result d83862a, rule ee14b30); SGSeg's revised texts give the same agreement (3d44316)
orientation_decision.exception: The plan's Stage 0 step 3 requires the orientation to be established from documentation and code, otherwise STOP. The supervisor approved an exception for this pilot: the training-split alignment (option 1) is used as text-to-image coordinate alignment, not as anatomical orientation.
orientation_decision.sensitivity: none: option 2 is not run (supervisor's decision)

known_limitation_vertical: An extra training-split check added by the project lead (rule 23d79a8, result 6f9b473) failed its pre-set criterion: up and down are not flipped (median lesion centroid row 66 for upper-only reports, 130 for lower-only reports), but for lower-only reports a median of only 13% of the lesion lies in the grid's lower band (rows 149-223), most of it in the middle band (lower-only agreement 82.1%, combined agreement 82.7%, both < 90%). The plan's equal-thirds grid is kept unchanged, as the plan requires (no regions from ground-truth masks). A Stage 1 failure may therefore reflect the grid rather than the idea.
